ways.label: Māori Saddle Route to Mataketake Hut

start.name: turn off to Māori Saddle Route
start.quote: The turn off to Māori Saddle Route is signposted 10 min after Māori Saddle Hut

via.name: pole markers at the edge of the open tops
via.quote: pole markers at the edge of the open tops

evidence: Māori Saddle Route is started from the Historic Haast to Paringa Cattle Track.
From the bush edge markers, follow the poled route for about 20 minutes to Mataketake Hut.

not_on_route.name: Historic Haast to Paringa Cattle Track
not_on_route.quote: Historic Haast to Paringa Cattle Track

doubts: The route starts at the signposted turn off on the Cattle Track, 10 min past Māori Saddle Hut (no feature), so start ref null; DOC's time counts from SH6. Shape one_way to the hut (a dead end); the text says to return via this route or Mica Mine Tops Route depending on weather, recorded as an exit. Section heading 'Turn off to Mataketake Hut' gives no separate time.
